item.title: Anthropic Quietly Pitches Its Own AI Safety Bill To Lawmakers: Reports

ns0:content.ns0:description: Anthropic representatives have quietly pitched lawmakers on a draft bill to regulate frontier AI safety.

item.description: The bill would let the government block a model's release or use only if it poses a foreseeable, imminent risk of more than $1 billion in damages, or of killing or seriously injuring more than 50 people, according to the report.
